name: 预测分析模型训练 - 销售 (2YJ)
description_en_html:
Overview

With this scope item, you can utilize the embedded predictive analytics functionality in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition sales business processes.

The scope item provides the following functionalities in different business scenarios:

The Quotation Conversion Rates scenario provides reliable predictions for the sales manager or sales representative to monitor the probability of a sales quotation being converted to a sales order, assisting the sales manager to plan more reliably.

The Sales Performance app allows the sales manager to forecast the achievable sales volumes and develop the sales plans periodically.

With the SAP Fiori app Predicted Delivery Delay, a sales representative can monitor the current delivery performance situation, and instantly recognize the effect of the delivered-as-requested ratio of sales orders, to prevent a critical delay of delivered goods, and thus increase customer satisfaction.

Key Process Flow

  • Train an embedded predictive model from the released predictive scenarios
  • Leverage embedded predictive analytics functionalities

Business Benefits

  • Decrease manual effort for sales planning and deliver more accurate sales forecasts
  • Provide reliable predictions for achievable sales volume
  • Increase customer satisfaction by achieving a better delivery performance
  • Increase working efficiency by providing better insight to sales manager for decision making
description_zh_html:
概览

通过此范围项目，您可以在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 销售业务流程中利用嵌入式预测分析功能。

此范围项目在不同的业务场景中提供以下功能：

报价转换率场景为销售经理或销售代表提供可靠的预测，以监控销售报价转换为销售订单的可能性，从而帮助销售经理更可靠地进行计划。

“销售绩效”应用允许销售经理预测可实现的销售量并定期制定销售计划。

使用 SAP Fiori 应用预测交货延迟，销售代表可以监控当前交货绩效情况，并立即识别销售订单按要求交货比率的影响，以防止交货严重延迟，从而提高客户满意度。

关键流程流

  • 训练已发布预测场景中的嵌入式预测模型。
  • 利用嵌入式预测分析功能

业务优势

  • 减少销售计划的手动工作量，提供更准确的销售预测
  • 为可实现的销售量提供可靠的预测
  • 通过提高交货绩效提高客户满意度
  • 为销售经理提供更好的决策洞察力，从而提高工作效率
